dogecoin.text:
@Dogecoin_Dan @DirkisSam @rakeau @DaisyCousens @AlboMP Abiding by laws determined by those we elect isn't any different.

The difference arises between democracies and *genuinely* authoritarian regimes. In democracies we trust them to do the right thing and hold them to account at the ballot box if they abuse that trust.

@Dogecoin_Dan @DirkisSam @rakeau @DaisyCousens @AlboMP There's an assumption built into the system of a degree of discernment & maturity among the electorate, which admittedly is rarely the case, but I'd dispute that those who challenge every little thing are the most discerning, mature or best informed. They could just be paranoid!
